subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word.

Elegant
solution:
The correct answer is: **Graceful.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Elegant"** means pleasingly graceful and stylish in appearance or manner. (शानदार)

 
 
• **Example:** She looked elegant in her evening gown at the gala.
 
 
 
• **"Graceful"** refers to having or showing grace or elegance. (सजीला)
 
 
• **Example:** The dancer moved in a graceful manner, captivating the audience.
 
 
 
• Hence, we can infer that the synonym of **'Elegant'** is **'Graceful'**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 2**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Mighty** (शक्तिशाली): Possessing great and impressive power or strength.

 
 
• **Example:** The mighty warrior fought bravely in the battle.
 
 
 
• **Ugly** (कुरूप): Unpleasant or repulsive in appearance.
 
 
• **Example:** The old house looked ugly and abandoned.
 
 
 
• **Tall** (लंबा): Of great or more than average height.
 
 
• **Example:** The tall building could be seen from miles away.
